idea: Multiset-first packing: enumerate multisets of sides from {1/d} (d up to about 3√n) by a knapsack. Maximise the sum subject to the count being n and the area being at most 1, then test the top candidates for exact packability. The test is a bottom-left/skyline backtracking search on the integer board of size lcm(d's) × lcm(d's), returning the first multiset that packs.
